title: Farnhorst A
description: Fünfzehn dicht gefiederte, bogenförmige Wedel aus einer engen Rosette, mit gelappten Fiederblättchen bis zur Spitze, jungen eingerollten Trieben und zwei älteren brauneren, flachen Wedeln.

review.notes: Round 1. Good: 1.3 x 0.7 m, fronds arch out of one centre with dry lower fronds and cast readable shadows. Defects: (1) form/style: every frond is a single row of identical oval leaflets at even spacing along a stiff stalk, so it reads as a cycad, palm or mimosa, not a fern (ref_14). Fern fronds are bipinnate and lacy, with pinnae that taper toward the tip and the base, plus a few unrolling fiddleheads. (2) The fronds stand stiffly upright and then hook down at the tip like whips; give them one continuous arch. (3) The lower dry fronds are pale cream/beige and lie flat on the ground like paper; use darker dry brown and lift them slightly. (4) At some frond tips the leaflets detach from the rachis (closeup top left). (5) Color: the green is dark teal rather than olive.
